subject: System Design
title: HTTP/3 and QUIC
description: Learn HTTP/3 and QUIC in one minute.

hook.text: HTTP/3 doesn't run on TCP. It runs on QUIC, a new transport protocol built on UDP.

buildup.text: QUIC eliminates TCP's head-of-line blocking. Each stream is independently delivered.

discovery.text: QUIC also builds in encryption (TLS 1.3) from the start and reduces connection setup to a single round trip.

twist.text: QUIC was invented by Google and initially dismissed. Now it powers 25% of all web traffic.

climax.text: HTTP/3 over QUIC is the biggest change to web transport since TCP was invented in 1974.

punchline.text: QUIC: faster, encrypted, and no head-of-line blocking.

quiz.question: What transport protocol does HTTP/3 use?
